title: Boone County 2026 zoning rewrite — October 7 Business Meeting and Public Hearing agenda content review

boundedFindings: No reviewed zoning-rewrite/adoption target term appears in the reliably extracted full two-page agenda.

One project-specific item combines a zoning map amendment with a Conditional Use Permit for an Electronic Message Board/Screen; this is not treated as Article 34 or zoning-rewrite adoption evidence.
The agenda includes Long Range Planning/Comprehensive Plan only as a standing Committee Reports heading and does not identify a rewrite item under that heading.
No reviewed zoning-rewrite/adoption target term appears in the reliably extracted full two-page agenda.

remainingAuthorityReview: October 7, 2026 Business Meeting and Public Hearing minutes were not linked on the official Planning Commission index snapshot archived on 2026-10-03, so final action/effectiveness remains unresolved.
authorityBoundary: These two reviewed October 7 agendas do not schedule or identify adoption of the 2026 zoning rewrite. This is a bounded finding about the agendas only; it does not prove that no action occurred during the meetings or in later legislative-body proceedings.
adoptedSignAuthority: Continue using the separately archived adopted Boone County Zoning Regulations Article 34 as sign-regulation authority unless newer reviewed official action records establish final adoption and effectiveness of replacement text.
